evidence: Labeled Consensus; directly alters stack element storage and execution mechanisms in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/script/interpreter.h.
rationale: The change addresses a speculative DoS vulnerability that only arises if future soft forks relax stack element limits beyond 520 bytes. Under current consensus rules, stack elements are strictly bounded, so mitigating deep-copy inflation for multi-kilobyte post-quantum items has no immediate claim on validation review attention.
